texts.title: The Patron's Match
texts.body: The patron has been thinking about {self.name}'s future, which is to say the patron's own. A house with no heir is a poor investment. There is a young person of {match.house}, {match.name}, of good sense and suitable age, whose family owes the patron a courtesy. It could be arranged within the year.

choices.accept_the_match: Accept. The house needs a future.

texts.title: A Match Is Proposed
texts.body: A go-between calls with a proposal: {match.name} of {match.house}. The families are of a kind that can sit at one table, the ages suit, and there is no blood between them. {self.name} is unmarried, and a house whose head has no heir is one illness from its end.
